lexicon.derivation: properly, the same as H5920 (עַל) used as a preposition (in the singular or plural often with prefix, or as conjunction with a particle following);
lexicon.strongs_def: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
lexicon.kjv_def: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

lexicon.strongs_def: to build (literally and figuratively)
lexicon.kjv_def: (begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), [idiom] surely.

lexicon.strongs_def: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
lexicon.kjv_def: court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, [idiom] great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).

lexicon.derivation: rarely יְרוּשָׁלַיִם; a dual (in allusion to its two main hills (the true pointing, at least of the former reading, seems to be that of H3390 (יְרוּשָׁלֵם))); probably from (the passive participle of) H3384 (יָרָה) and H7999 (שָׁלַם); founded peaceful;
lexicon.strongs_def: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
lexicon.kjv_def: Jerusalem.

lexicon.derivation: a primitive relative pronoun (of every gender and number);
lexicon.strongs_def: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
lexicon.kjv_def: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.

lexicon.strongs_def: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
lexicon.kjv_def: Judah.

lexicon.derivation: an interrogative pronoun of persons, as H4100 (מָה) is of things,
lexicon.strongs_def: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
lexicon.kjv_def: any (man), [idiom] he, [idiom] him, [phrase] O that! what, which, who(-m, -se, -soever), [phrase] would to God.

lexicon.strongs_def: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
lexicon.kjv_def: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

lexicon.strongs_def: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
lexicon.kjv_def: folk, men, nation, people.

lexicon.strongs_def: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
lexicon.kjv_def: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).

lexicon.strongs_def: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
lexicon.kjv_def: angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.

lexicon.strongs_def: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
lexicon.kjv_def: accompanying, against, and, as ([idiom] long as), before, beside, by (reason of), for all, from (among, between), in, like, more than, of, (un-) to, with(-al).

lexicon.strongs_def: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
lexicon.kjv_def: arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, [phrase] shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, [idiom] mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, [phrase] perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.
